svg.title: Hindcast as built
svg.desc: On an operator workstation signed in with Entra ID, Hindcast's capture command reads the providers' status pages and postmortems, and the Radar charts are downloaded in the browser. The Azure CLI and Hindcast's code store the captured files in Blob Storage, and Hindcast's ingestion reads them back and writes the evidence, the extracts, and the answer-key analyzer results there with its own Entra token. Hindcast's code calls the pinned model deployments through the Foundry project with the Responses API; its investigate command keeps the investigator prompt agent's version in the project, runs that agent, executes its case tools and library searches on the workstation, screens every tool item with Prompt Shields and masks personal data in the answer with PII detection, and writes the result file there; its challenge command runs a challenger agent on one finding the same way; its seal command runs the same agent on a sealed case, uploads the result to Blob Storage, and commits only its hash. It calls Content Understanding on the Foundry resource, whose three analyzers use the gpt-5.4-mini and text-embedding-3-large deployments, with a role assigned only while extraction runs. Its index command embeds the library chunks through the Foundry resource endpoint and pushes them to the library index in Azure AI Search, in Switzerland North, which the investigator's library search and the leak check query with an Entra token. A Foundry evaluation run, started in the portal or by Hindcast's evaluation code, calls a deployment as its judge. Hindcast's judge command sends each scored run, with the text the run cites, to claude-opus-5-5 on the Anthropic API, outside Azure, with an API key from the local environment file. git reaches GitHub through pull requests. Hindcast's commands send their spans to Application Insights, which the deployed page also writes to (the deployment diagram); the Foundry project is not connected to it. The Foundry resource, the storage account, and the search service accept no keys; traces use the Application Insights connection string.
svg.text: Called by the service, not the code
Azure in Sweden Central, AI Search in Switzerland North · Entra tokens, no Azure keys · traces use the Application Insights connection string
